info.name: Rapid Capsule API Collection v6.0
info.description:
Complete API documentation for Rapid Capsule Telemedicine Platform.

**Patient API**: https://api.rapidcapsule.com/api
**Specialist API**: https://api.rapidcapsule.com/api
**Admin API**: https://admin.rapidcapsule.com/admin-api

Total Endpoints: 1013

All endpoints enriched with Swagger/OpenAPI documentation including request bodies, query parameters, path parameters, and response examples.

Includes: Authentication (JWT, OAuth, Biometric/WebAuthn), Appointments, Health Checkup (Infermedica AI), Prescriptions, Pharmacy (Orders, Inventory, Compliance), Wallets & Payments (Paystack), RxGPT AI Prescription Analysis, Health Integrations, Clinical Notes, Messaging, Recovery Module, Eka AI Companion, Admin Dashboard & Analytics

Created by Bassey Eyo (eyobassey@gmail.com) - Founder & CTO
API docs enriched Feb 2026
